name: ElevenLabs
description: Text to speech, voice cloning and transcription through ElevenLabs.
long_description:
ElevenLabs' own server, run as a local process on Python. It turns text into speech, transcribes audio, and reaches the voices your account has.

Every generation is billed to your ElevenLabs account, and the audio lands as a file on this machine.

auth.instructions: Create an ElevenLabs API key and paste it here. Generations are billed to that account.

risk.notes: Spends your ElevenLabs credits and writes audio files to this machine.
